# Scrollwell

> Scrollwell makes Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad creative for health and wellness DTC brands: short Reels and 4:5 feed statics built from the brand's own product photos, with every caption checked against Meta's health-claim ad policies before delivery. Founded and run by Leon Thompson.

## Offer
- Pilot: $750 one-time. 20 ad concepts in 14 days, Reels and statics, one revision round. Credited to month 1 if the client continues.
- Retainer: $1,800 per month. 10 new concepts every week plus a weekly refresh of the top ad. Cancel with 14 days' notice.
- Creative Refresh add-on: $500 per month. The client's 5 best ads re-cut with new hooks each month.

## Who it is for
Supplement, skincare, functional food and pet health brands that already run Meta ads and need more creative volume.

## How it works
1. Free 15-minute ad audit call: https://cal.com/scrollwell/ad-creative-audit
2. Pilot: 20 concepts in 2 weeks.
3. Keep the winners; stay on retainer or leave with everything paid for.

## Policies
- No disease cure, treat or prevent claims; no before-and-after body shaming; no copy that singles out a reader's body.
- Clients approve every product claim. Ads run from the client's own ad account. Meta approval is never guaranteed.
